Job Description Test Automation
Designation - Senior Test Analyst (5-8 years) / Lead Test Analyst (9 -12+ years)
Using a suite of modern tools, the Automation Tester will play a pivotal role in helping us to automate our move towards a truly continuous integration and continuous deployment environment. You will work with our product and development teams to ensure that we are constantly analysing the automated tests that we design and execute for each of our products.
You will report to the QA Manager, work alongside the Test Lead, product and development teams to ensure a high standard of quality in our products. You will carry out automated functional testing on our products. You will have the chance to test modern products based on Microsoft .NET technology.
You will design, maintain and execute suites automated tests using modern languages and tools such as C#, Visual Studio, Selenium, Playwright, Appium, Mocha, JavaScript, TypeScript and Microsoft Azure DevOps.
You will be responsible for working through and developing our backlog to make constant improvements and additions to our existing automated tests. You will review and automate existing manual test cases. You will also be responsible for creating and reviewing defects, tracking their progress from their discovery through to their resolution, ensuring that they are adequately documented and tested.
Over time your role will grow and become more varied as you begin to test a larger variety of products across the NEC SWS. We are constantly developing new and cutting edge, scalable solutions and we need a highly skilled QA expert who embraces problem solving on products built with new, well-structured code as well as elements of legacy code.
You will be someone who likes to push boundaries and enjoys rising to a challenge. We are a committed and supportive team with a can do mindset.
Key Responsibilities
  • Drive the implementation of modern test automation frameworks and tools.
  • Oversee test architecture, ensuring scalability and maintainability of automation solutions.
  • Promote shift-left testing practices and support developers in embedding quality.
  • Implementation of automation frameworks for middleware and backend service-based applications in critical infrastructure design.
  • Designing and executing automated tests on the latest revisions of the software.
  • Participating in the development of our automated testing framework, assisting our move towards automated testing in a CI/CD environment.
  • Interpreting requirements from existing manual test cases and specification documents.
    Liaising with Manual Testers and / or Business Analysts to understand the requirements.
  • Liaising with the product and development teams to ensure that our backlog is up to date
  • Providing estimates regarding the test effort required to complete work.
  • Raising bugs and liaising with the development team from discovery through to resolution
  • Setting up and configuring the testing environment and associated database(s)
  • Preparing the test execution report and sharing it with stakeholders.
Required technical skills and experience
  • Experience with C# / Java Script/ Type Script
  • 6 to 10 years of experience in Test Automation using various tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Appium, Mocha etc
  • Experience developing and executing automated test cases for User Interfaces
  • Knowledge of software development in a web and desktop environment
Required soft skills and experience
  • Clear and concise communicator
  • Able to prioritise between several tasks at any one time
  • Able to work independently and as part of a team
  • Detailed and effective written communication skills for documenting the features tested and bugs found
  • Highly organized, detail oriented, extremely responsive
  • Be comfortable discussing technical aspects of projects with other testers, developers business owners.
Desirable skills and experience
  • Experience using Azure DevOps
  • Experience using Selenium and Playwright or equivalent tools
  • Experience using BrowserStack or equivalent cloud-based tools
  • Experience with various reporting libraries such as Extent, Allure etc
  • Usage of latest AI tools.
  • Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience testing User Interfaces and databases
  • Youll have ISTQB/ISEB Foundation certifications or equivalent certifications or be working towards achieving them.
  • Experience coordinating with external/Offshore QA resources


Qualifications
Graduate


Additional Information
Good Communication Skills required.

Summary: We are seeking a visionary Physics-Based Simulation Architect to lead the design and deployment of advanced engineering simulation solutions across manufacturing and industrial domains. This role demands deep expertise in Multiphysics simulation, first-principles modeling, and digital twin development, combined with strategic leadership in system-level architectures. You will leverage cutting-edge platforms such as NVIDIA Omniverse, cloud simulation environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), and MBSE methodologies to deliver scalable, high-performance solutions. Join us to drive innovation, enable next-generation simulation architectures, and solve complex engineering challenges for global clients.

Roles & Responsibilities: Architect simulation methods and solutions across Multiphysics domains (mechanical, thermal, fluid, electrical) while orchestrating cross-domain workflows. Design and implement pipelines leveraging NVIDIA platform-based simulation tools such as Omniverse, PhysX, Modulus, and Isaac Sim, integrating physics-based rendering, digital twins, and real-time visualization in cloud or hybrid environments. Leverage cloud-native infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP) to automate, scale, and orchestrate simulation workloads. Apply MBSE methodologies (SysML, Cameo, Capella) to formally align system requirements with model execution. Implement cross-domain and hybrid simulations by combining discrete-event modeling for factory workflows with physics-based models for engineering processes such as material, fluid, and thermal. Champion co-simulation architectures, fast-running simulation models, and tool integration across commercial software (ANSYS, COMSOL, Abaqus) and scripting environments (Python, MATLAB, Modelica). Lead validation and verification efforts by correlating simulation outcomes with experimental datasets and real-world performance. Provide technical leadership and mentorship, guiding development teams and collaborating with cross-functional teams. Actively lead and participate in sales pursuits and pre-sales engagements, including discussions and presentations of capabilities and solutions to potential clients and internal stakeholders. Contribute to industry thought leadership through patents, whitepapers, POVs, proof of concepts, conference and academic presentations, and capability showcases. Work with global clients and cross-functional teams in a multicultural and distributed environment. Professional & Technical SkillsMust-Have Skills: Deep expertise in physics-based modeling and simulation across multiple engineering domains, with a strong foundation in numerical methods, PDE solvers, continuum mechanics, reduced-order modeling, and real-time co-simulation. Extensive hands-on experience with commercial simulation tools such as ANSYS, COMSOL, MOOSE, LAMMPS, OpenFOAM, and similar platforms. Proven ability in creating digital twins and developing high-fidelity physics-based visualizations to support real-time simulation and decision-making for industrial applications. Experience in generating synthetic data to validate and test real-time industrial simulation applications. Strong background in cloud-based simulation workflows, including automation, orchestration, and deployment of scalable simulation pipelines on platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP. Solid understanding of Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), with experience in aligning system requirements, architecture models, and simulation execution using tools like SysML, Cameo, or Capella. Comprehensive knowledge of Discrete Event Simulation (DES) and hybrid modeling approaches to simulate discrete manufacturing processes alongside continuous physics-based models. Significant industry experience in manufacturing, industrial automation, automotive, or aerospace sectors.Good-to-Have Skills: Proficiency in scripting and automation using languages such as Python, C++, and MATLAB for simulation workflows. Experience in digital twin development for applications like factory planning, robotics simulation, and predictive maintenance. Working knowledge of NVIDIA Omniverse and Isaac Sim for advanced simulation and visualization. Familiarity with FMI/FMU standards, OpenModelica, OpenUSD, and robotics simulation frameworks. Exposure to AI/ML-driven simulation workflows, including Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs), surrogate modeling, and generative AI tools for model creation and behavior prediction.Additional Info: Cand should have 12 to16+ years of experience Bachelor s or Master s in Engineering, Physics, or Ph.D. in related field. This position is based at Bengaluru/Pune location.

Qualification 15 years full time education

  • Create architecture artifacts: solution blueprints, reference architectures, integration diagrams, and technical roadmaps.
  • Collaborate with security and infrastructure teams on cloud-native deployments (AWS or Azure) and DevSecOps strategies.
  • Mentor technical teams and support architectural governance across project delivery.

  • 12+ years of relevant experience in designing developing technology solutions on an enterprise-scale for Life Science RD space;
  • Strong knowledge of clinical systems landscape (e.g., EDC, CTMS, eTMF, eCOA, CDMS, SDTM, ADaM, SAS).
  • Expertise in cloud architecture using AWS and/or Azure including serverless, containers, API management, and security best practices.

  • Demonstrated expertise in building scalable data pipelines, real-time streaming architectures, and enterprise-grade data lakes and warehouses.
